description: Connects this tablet to Decadent: your coffees, your shots and the profile for the next one.

DecadentUrl.label: Decadent address
DecadentUrl.description: Where this tablet reports to. Leave it as it is unless Decadent told you otherwise.

PairCode.label: Pairing code
PairCode.description: Only when Decadent asks for it: the six digits from Settings → Machine. It works once and expires after ten minutes.

TabletName.label: Name shown in Decadent
TabletName.description: How this tablet appears under Settings → Machine.
